purpose: Frozen confirmation design before any new audit or paired test evaluation. Separate deletion-split variability from Original training variability.

selection.rule: min feasible selection J; ties earlier epoch, smaller lr, stable id
selection.freeze: complete algorithm and exact stopping epoch before all confirmation runs; use fixed last.pt for new seeds; no reselecting

comparators: SalUn with unchanged inherited code and hyperparameters
audit: One pass for each prespecified candidate/Original after method freeze; never switch configuration or stopping epoch from audit.
test: Paired references and original benchmark evaluator only after matching immutable audit receipt; report all runs and failures.
reporting: Report canonical split-confirmation and five independent-Original results separately; mean per-run absolute gaps before aggregation, sample SD; discovery seed is labelled.
